speaker: Patient
text: My baby gets worse when he cries, feeds, or when his neck is bent forward. It actually seems to help a little bit if we extend his neck back. He also sometimes vomits after eating. speaker: Doctor
text: The positional nature of the stridor, worsening with flexion and improving with extension, combined with the confirmed imaging, is classic for Vascular Ring Syndrome, specifically a Double Aortic Arch. DIAGNOSIS READY: Vascular Ring Syndrome (Double Aortic Arch)
